% stays MathJax's, as a display with two other pictures does: TeX would
% set the math between them as text. MathJax has no quantikz
% environment, so the display is red (test/expected.json).
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{quantikz}
\begin{document}
Two circuits.
\begin{align*}
\begin{quantikz} & \gate{H} & \qw \end{quantikz} \\
\begin{quantikz} & \gate{X} & \qw \end{quantikz}
\end{align*}
\end{document}
